bio.text: Pat Boyd was first elected to the Connecticut House of Representatives on November 8, 2016, and represents the 50th Assembly District in Eastern Connecticut.
Born in Norwich and raised in Moosup, he earned a B.A. from Eastern Connecticut State University and an M.A. from Sacred Heart University.
Boyd has worked as an educator for more than 20 years and, according to the page, is Dean of Students, coach and teacher at the Pomfret School.
He is a volunteer firefighter and emergency medical responder with the Pomfret Volunteer Fire Department, where he has been company president since 2014.
